ui.Custom Details (e.g. 45-year-old from Lo: Zambiri zanu (mwachitsanzo, wazaka 45, wochokera ku London, nthabwala zonyoza)
ui.Describe yourself to the AI. It will use: Fotokozani za inu nokha kwa AI. Idzagwiritsa ntchito izi kuti mayankho ake ndi zolosera za mawu zikugwirizane nanu.
ui.Each language has its own phrases: switc: Chilankhulo chilichonse chili ndi mawu ake: kusintha chilankhulo kumasunga onse. Liwu, kumvetsera, mayankho oganiziridwa ndi mawu a TexCom amatsatira chilankhulo.

ui.Someone using TexCom would like to talk: Winawake wogwiritsa ntchito TexCom akufuna kulankhula nanu. Akuitaneni kuti ndani?
ui.Talk with someone anywhere: send them a: Lankhulani ndi aliyense kulikonse: mutumizireni ulalo (kapena onetsani khodi). Angagwiritse ntchito foni kapena kompyuta iliyonse, kapena TexCom yake. Inu mumasankha amene alowe. Nonse awiri mufunika intaneti.
ui.TexCom can’t use the microphone. Allow M: TexCom singagwiritse ntchito maikolofoni. Lolani Maikolofoni ndi Kuzindikira Mawu a TexCom mu Zokonda.
ui.TexCom couldn’t get the {language} phras: TexCom sinathe kupeza mawu a {language}. Amafunika intaneti koyamba.
ui.TexCom couldn’t save your phrases (the s: TexCom sinathe kusunga mawu anu (malo osungira adzaza). Kusintha kwanu komaliza kungatayike TexCom ikatsekedwa. Sungani mndandanda wa mawu anu mu fayilo mu Zokonda > Deta.

Fayiloyo si mndandanda wa mawu a TexCom.
Umenewo si ulalo kapena khodi ya zokambirana.
ui.The features below run privately on the: Zinthu zili m'munsizi zimagwira ntchito mwachinsinsi pa chipangizo, choncho zimafunika pulogalamu ya TexCom ya iPhone, iPad, Mac kapena Android. Sizipezeka pa msakatuli wa intaneti.
ui.The phrases it replaced are in Settings: Mawu amene inalowa m'malo mwake ali mu Zokonda > Deta > Bwezeretsani mawu akale.
ui.There isn’t room to keep a copy of your: Palibe malo osungira kope la mawu anu apano, choncho sanasinthidwe. Asungeni mu fayilo kaye (Zokonda > Deta).
ui.There’s no {language} voice on this devi: Palibe liwu la {language} pa chipangizo ichi, choncho TexCom idzawerenga ndi liwu limene ili nalo. Mutha kuonjezera mawu mu zokonda za chipangizo (Kupezeka > Zolankhulidwa kapena Kulankhula).
ui.They become your {language} phrases, to: Awa akhala mawu anu a {language}, oti musinthe momwe mukufunira. Mawu anu a {current} akhala momwemo: bwererani nthawi iliyonse.
ui.They were translated by machine and have: Awa anamasuliridwa ndi makina ndipo sanaunikidwe ndi wolankhula {language}.
ui.This device can’t listen in {language},: Chipangizo ichi sichingamvetsere mu {language}, choncho maikolofoni imamvetsera m'chilankhulo cham'mbuyo.
ui.This link is incomplete. Ask for the lin: Ulalo uwu suli wathunthu. Funsaninso ulalo.
ui.Type or choose a phrase first, then pres: Lembani kapena sankhani mawu kaye, kenako dinani ♡ kuti muwonjezere ku Zokondedwa.
ui.Use them instead of the English ones?: Mugwiritse ntchito awa m'malo mwa a Chingerezi?
ui.You have changed this phrase set. Save i: Mwasintha mndandanda wa mawu uwu. Musunge musanatsegule wina?

ui.Your previous phrases are back. (The one: Mawu anu akale abwerera. (Amene munali kugwiritsa ntchito asungidwa, choncho mutha kubwerera mwanjira yomweyo.)

help.help_2: TexCom imakuthandizani kuyankhula polemba kapena posankha mawu opangidwa okonzeka, ndipo imawalankhula mokweza.
help.help_3: Mukugwiritsa ntchito TexCom pa msakatuli. Chilichonse pano chimagwira ntchito kupatulapo zolembedwa mapulogalamu okha, zomwe zimafunika pulogalamu ya TexCom ya iPhone, iPad kapena Mac.
help.help_14: Dinani mawu kuti muwonjezere kubokosilo, kenako dinani Lankhulani. Mutha kuwonjezera mawu angapo, kapena lembani zambiri mozungulira.
help.help_15: Mawu ena amayikidwa kuti ayankhule nthawi yomweyo mukawadina ("Instant message", onani Sintha).
help.help_16: Bokosi la mawu ndikusakanso. Pamene mukulemba, mndandanda ukuwonetsa mawu omwe ali ndi mawu kuyambira pomwe mumayimilira, koma, chizindikiro (ndi zina zotero). Dinani imodzi ndikulowetsa mawuwo. Mwachitsanzo, lembani Ndatopa. tiyindipo dinani "Si kapu yanga ya tiyi." Mzere waKufananiza umasonyeza pamene mndandanda wasefedwa; dinani ✕ kuti muwonenso mawu aliwonse.
help.help_17: Njira zazifupi: lembani njira yachidule ya mawu otsatiridwa ndi / ndipo imakhala mawu onse. Mwachitsanzo, ngati "Moni" ali ndi njira yachidule ya h, kulemba h/ kumapereka "Moni".
help.help_18: Mawu omwe ali ndi [***] amaika dzina lanu (Zokonda> Dzina lanu).
help.help_20: Pa sikirini yopapatiza mabatani ena amasunthira mu⋯ menyu yomwe ili kumapeto kwa chida.
help.help_22: Chotsani bokosi la mawu (ndi mbiri ya macheza).
help.help_26: Mverani mnzanuyo: kuyatsa kapena kutseka maikolofoni (kufiira pamene mukumvetsera). mapulogalamu okha
help.help_32: SOS: beeps S-O-S mu Morse code kuti muyimbire thandizo.
help.help_34: Zokonda: zimawonjezera zomwe zili m'bokosi lazomwe mumakonda.
help.help_36: Sinthani: kuyatsa ndi kuzimitsa mawonekedwe a Sinthani (onani Sintha).
help.help_40: Gawani malemba omwe ali mubokosi (mwachitsanzo mu uthenga).
help.help_42: Mawuwa amagawidwa mu magulu. Dinani gulu kuti muwone mawu ake; Zonse zikuwonetsa mawu aliwonse.
help.help_43: Pa foni yomwe ili chowongoka, dinani Magawo pamwamba pa mawuwa kuti musankhe imodzi.
help.help_44: Zokonda zimakhala ndi mawu omwe mumagwiritsa ntchito kwambiri. Onjezani imodzi ndi batani la ♡, kapena chongani Favorites mukamakonza mawu.
help.help_45: Yendetsani (kapena pindani) mindandanda kuti muwone zambiri.
help.help_46: Pazenera lalikulu, kokerani kapamwamba pakati pa mizati iwiriyo kuti ikhale yokulirapo.
help.help_48: Dinani ✎ Sinthani. Liwu lililonse ndi gulu limakhala ndi batani la ✎, ndipo "+ Onjezani mawu" / "+ Onjezani gulu" amawonekera pamwamba pamndandanda.
help.help_49: Mu mkonzi mungathe kusintha mawu, chizindikiro (mtundu kapena matani emoji), chidule, ndi magulu omwe alimo.
help.help_52: Muzosintha, koka ⠿ chogwirizira kuti kusanzaninso mawu kapena magulu.
help.help_56: Press 🎙 ndipo TexCom imvera munthu amene mukulankhula naye. Zomwe amanena zimawonekera pamwamba pazenera, ndipo TexCom ikhoza kupereka mayankho. mapulogalamu okha
help.help_57: Zokonda> Smart AI> Yambani kumvetsera TexCom ikatsegula imayatsa maikolofoni nthawi iliyonse mukayambitsa TexCom.
help.help_58: Ndi kiyibodi yolumikizidwa, munthu winayo akhoza kukanikiza batani la ` (pafupi ndi 1 kapena Z), lembani, ndikudina Enter. Mawu awo amawonekera pamwamba pa chinsalu. Esc yalephereka.
help.help_59: Pa foni yawo kapena kompyuta, kulikonse
help.help_60: Zokonda> Kukambirana> Yambitsani kucheza… kumakupatsani ulalo ndi code yayifupi. Gawani ulalo (mu meseji kapena imelo), kapena aloleni iwo asane khodi ya QR.
help.help_61: Atha kugwiritsa ntchito foni kapena kompyuta iliyonse (amangotsegula ulalo), kapena TexCom yawo (Lowani nawo zokambirana…, kenako matani ulalo kapena lembani kachidindo).
help.help_62: Akayesa kulowa nawo, TexCom imakufunsani kuti: Lolani kapena Kanikani. Palibe amene amajowina popanda kunena kwanu. Kukambirana kulikonse kumakhala ndi ulalo watsopano.
help.help_63: Zomwe mukunena zimawoneka zazikulu kwambiri pazenera zawo. Zomwe amalemba zimawonekera mu mbiri yanu yochezera.
help.help_64: Malo omwe ali pamwamba pa macheza akuwonetsa yemwe mukuyankhula naye. Dinani End kuti mumalize.
help.help_65: Werengani mauthenga a anzanu mokweza (Zokonda> Zokambirana) amalankhula mauthenga awo kwa inu.
help.help_68: Zokonda> Smart AI> Onetsani mbiri ya macheza amasonyeza zokambirana mpaka pano, pansi pa magulu (kapena pamwamba pa mawu omwe ali pa foni yomwe ili mowongoka). Imawonekera nthawi zonse mukakambirana pa intaneti.
help.help_69: Kokani chikhomo pamwamba pake kuti chikhale chachikulu kapena chaching'ono.
help.help_71: Izi zimayenda mwachinsinsi pa chipangizo chanu (Apple Intelligence), kotero palibe chomwe munganene chimatumizidwa kulikonse. Amafuna posachedwapa iPhone, iPad kapena Mac.
help.help_72: Mayankho operekedwa: inu kapena mnzanu mukamayankhula, mayankho ofikira atatu amawonekera pamwamba pa mndandanda wa mawu, olembedwa ndi 🧠. Dinani imodzi kuti mugwiritse ntchito. Lembani ^ kuti mufunse malingaliro atsopano.
help.help_73: Zolosera za mawu otsatirawa: pamene mukulemba, mawu otsatirawa mwina amawonekera ngati mabatani. Dinani imodzi kuti muwonjezere.
help.help_74: Smart Expand: lembani cholembera chachifupi ndikumaliza ndi @ (mwachitsanzo need drink@) ndipo TexCom ilembe ngati chiganizo chonse. Yatsani mu Zikhazikiko> Smart AI.
help.help_75: AI persona (Zikhazikiko> Smart AI> Sinthani AI persona…): auzeni AI za inu, monga kamvekedwe kanu, matanthauzidwe, momwe mungayankhulire za chithandizo chanu choyankhulirana, ndi china chirichonse chomwe chiyenera kudziwa, kotero malingaliro amamveka ngati inu.
help.help_78: Mawu: sankhani mawu, kukweza, liwiro ndi voliyumu, ndikudina Liwu loyesa kuti mumve.
help.help_80: Data: lowetsani mawu kuchokera mufayilo, tsegulani kapena sungani mawu, kapena gawani.
help.help_82: Kusintha TexCom sikusintha kapena kuchotsa mawu anu, magulu kapena zokonda.
help.help_83: Zosintha zikabweretsa mawu atsopano, TexCom imakuuzani kamodzi, ndipo Zokonda> Deta imawonetsa Onjezani mawu atsopano a TexCom…. Amapita mugulu laMawu atsopano kuti muyang'ane. Sungani zomwe mumakonda ndikuchotsa zina zonse.
help.help_84: Kuti musunge kopi, kapena kusuntha mawu anu ku chipangizo china, gwiritsani ntchito Zokonda> Deta> Sungani mawu akuti… ndi Tsegulani seti ya mawu….
